title: Scrapbench nugget: latency & cost quicksheet
content:
Quick personal mini-sheet for small runs — keep this messy. Use when prototyping batch / cache / quant profiles. Not canonical.

Context:
- Trying lightweight samples to decide default batch size recommendations for small tail workloads (<= 8 tokens per request typical).
- Comparing p50 latency vs realized token cost for 3 model variants (base, q4, q5) on a single A10G instance.
- Want fast heuristics to pick fallback model under load.

Raw run table (hand-scribble style):
Date | Model | Config | batch_sz | p50_ms | p95_ms | tokens_per_req | requests | total_tokens | est_cost_usd | notes
2025-11-10 | Llama-70B | float32 | 1 | 210 | 420 | 16 | 120 | 1920 | 0.021 | warm cold-start; no cache
2025-11-10 | Llama-70B | float32 | 4 | 280 | 540 | 12 | 300 | 3600 | 0.039 | batching helps throughput, latency up for single
2025-12-03 | Llama-70B | q4_0 | 1 | 145 | 310 | 16 | 150 | 2400 | 0.012 | quant gains, artifacts in math ops small
2025-12-03 | Llama-70B | q4_0 | 8 | 290 | 610 | 12 | 640 | 7680 | 0.038 | best cost per token but p95 large
2026-01-21 | Llama-70B | q5_0 | 2 | 120 | 260 | 16 | 200 | 3200 | 0.016 | sweet spot for p50 and cost
2026-02-12 | Llama-13B | q4_fast | 1 | 60 | 120 | 14 | 400 | 5600 | 0.011 | good latency, lower quality on few examples

Quick heuristics notes:
- If p50 target < 150ms: prefer smaller model (13B q4_fast) or q5_0 on 70B with batch_sz <=2.
- If cost target < $0.02 per 1k tokens: consider batch_sz >=4 with q4_0 but watch p95.
- Enable KV-prefix cache when >30% of requests share same prompt prefix — reduced tokens_per_req by ~20-35% in small test.

To-do / open questions (scratch):
- Run a 3-day tracer with KV cache enabled in-prod-like traffic (spiky bursts) and log miss/eviction counts — Lin to add trace IDs to PR 811.
- Check whether compilation kernels change p95 distribution for q5_0 under sequence length 64 vs 256.
- Create a tiny A/B to route 5% traffic to q5_0 as canary and compare perceived quality (user-facing CLS).

Quick formulas I scribbled (approx):
- est_cost_usd = total_tokens/1000 * rate_per_1k_tokens  (rate examples used: float32 0.011, q4_0 0.005, q5_0 0.006)
- cost_per_request = tokens_per_req/1000 * rate_per_1k_tokens

Notes to self (imperative):
- Keep this brief — transfer salient rows to shared bench sheet when consistent patterns emerge (3+ runs same config).
- Annotate any runs with spike incidents (network jitter, host maintenance) — that'll explain odd p95s.

Slack refs and quick bookmarks:
- #serving-runtime thread: "q5 rollout frag"  (see thread timestamp 2026-01-21 11:45)
- GH PR 811: runtime patch for continuous batching logging (instrumentation missing on singletons)

Last mini-actions:
- 2026-02-10: note — q5_0 2x batch run flaked; re-ran 2026-02-12 and kept results above.
- 2026-02-15: shared this doc with Kai; asked for quick micro-A/B run next week.

End of scrapbench nugget. Keep messy; this is my single-file scratch memory for quick decisions.
